candidate.definition_en: To grow or develop in a healthy, vigorous, or highly successful way.

senses.definition_en: To grow or develop in a healthy, vigorous, or highly successful way.
examples: Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
Few businesses can flourish without proper financial planning.
The arts continue to flourish in this historic city.
